Title: TC-03.1 [AC-03.4] SLA succeeds when a first response is sent before failure (test SLA)

Step Action: Precondition check: Lakeview Response SLA active and default; TEST item: titles starting SLA-TEST, warn 5 min, fail 10 min, 24/7.
Create a case titled 'SLA-TEST <n> success', any category; Save; note the time.
Step Expected: SLA KPI instance First Response By – Case is In progress.

Step Action: Within 5 minutes set First Response Sent = Yes; Save; refresh the SLA grid.
Step Expected: KPI instance status Succeeded; Succeeded On filled in.

Title: TC-03.2 [AC-03.5] SLA warns then fails without a response (test SLA)

Step Action: Create a case titled 'SLA-TEST <n> warn and fail'; Save; note the time.
After about 5 minutes refresh the SLA grid.

Title: TC-03.3 [AC-03.6] SLA clock pauses while the case is On Hold

Step Action: Precondition check: SLA item allows pause and resume with an On Hold pause condition.
Create an SLA-TEST case; after 2 minutes set Status Reason = On Hold; Save.
Wait 6 minutes, then set status back to In Progress.
Step Expected: KPI resumes; Warning/Failure times shift by the paused time (no warning reached during hold).

Title: TC-03.4 [AC-03.1–03.3] Business SLA uses business hours and category durations

Step Action: Precondition check: Business SLA items and business-hours calendar configured (Next phase).
Create a Complaint case on a weekday during business hours.
Step Expected: Warning time = Created On + 9 business hours; Failure = + 27 business hours.
Warning = + 2 business hours; Failure = + 6 business hours.

Step Action: Create a case on Friday at 4:30 pm.
